title: MarkdStage — Markdown presentation tool with editable PowerPoint export
description: An open-source tool for creating slides from Markdown. Available in GitHub Copilot Canvas, a Windows app, and the CLI, with a presentation window and PDF/PowerPoint export.
heroDescription: Create slides in Markdown with text, bullet lists, code blocks, diagrams, and speaker notes. Keep one source through themed rendering, presentation, layout review, and PDF or editable PowerPoint export.
heroAlt: An architecture slide rendered in MarkdStage's light theme, connecting a browser to an API and a database.
heroNote: Edit, present, and export slides from Markdown files.
examplesDescription: Switch between examples to view the rendered slides and their Markdown source. You can also download the example Markdown files.
markdownAlt: A dark slide with a heading, three bullet points, and syntax-highlighted JavaScript.
architectureAlt: An architecture diagram connecting a browser, API, and database, with positions, icons, and connectors defined in Architecture DSL.
markdownDescription: Write headings, text, bullet lists, and code blocks in Markdown and display them as slides. Code blocks support syntax highlighting, and Mermaid is available when automatic diagram layout is useful.
architectureDescription: Create architecture diagrams by writing JSON-based Architecture DSL inside Markdown. Use it when positions, icons, connectors, and theme-aware composition should remain intentional and stable.
editorDescription: The Architecture Editor lets you edit nodes and connectors visually. Saving updates the Architecture DSL in your Markdown file, keeping the diagram part of the same source used for presentation and export.
editorAlt: The MarkdStage Architecture Editor, with an API node selected and its position and style available for editing.

steps.title: Write in Markdown.
steps.body: Create a Markdown file in a text editor. Place --- after a blank line to separate slides. You can also track changes with Git.

steps.title: Check the layout.
steps.body: Adjust themes and diagram positions. Use the output preview to check whether your content fits on 16:9 slides.

steps.title: Present and share.
steps.body: View speaker notes on the presenter screen while displaying slides on another screen. You can also export to PDF, or to PowerPoint where text, tables, code, and diagrams stay editable.

startDescription: Choose GitHub Copilot Canvas, the Windows app, or the CLI. Each can load Markdown files and display them as slides.
cliDescription: Preview, present, validate, and export slides from the command line. The GitHub Copilot App is not required, and you can also use the CLI from Codex or Claude Code.
cliRequirements: Requires Node.js 24 or later and Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome, or Chromium.
cliNext: Save your Markdown as slides.md and run the command above. If you do not have a deck yet, get one from “Download Markdown” in the Explore section. Select “Start presentation” in the screen that opens to launch the presentation window.
desktopDescription: A Windows app that opens Markdown files and displays slides. View the current slide, next slide, and speaker notes while presenting. The GitHub Copilot App is not required.
desktopDetail: Portable builds · x64 / ARM64 · Checksums included
canvasDescription: Display slides in the GitHub Copilot App canvas. Ask Copilot to create Markdown or revise diagrams, or open Markdown files directly to display them.
canvasPrompt: Install MarkdStage at user scope from the following GitHub repository folder.
canvasWarning: The Extension runs local code. Review its contents before installing and use a trusted release.
macNote: is available as a separate project.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
copyUnavailable: Clipboard is unavailable. Select the text and copy it manually.
